Question:
What fraction of a full circle does a central angle of \(180^\circ\) represent? First calculate \(180\div360\). Calculate: \(180\div360=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p193_q3_question_en.svg)
Solution: \(180\div360=0.5\), which is half of a full circle.
